name: Blue Day
source:
Fang finally becomes a rockstar. 

Post E2 psychological horror mod centered around Fang.

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3399133818]Steam Workshop[/url] and [url=https://rentry.co/snootmods#another-snoot-game-mods-list]Snoot Game Mods List[/url]]

Made for Snoot Jam 2.
translation:
Fang終於成了搖滾明星。

一部以Fang為中心的心理恐怖模組，故事接續第二結局。

［摘自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3399133818]Steam創意工坊[/url]及[url=https://rentry.co/snootmods#another-snoot-game-mods-list]《Snoot Game》模組列表[/url]］
